description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Promulgated the Advance Passenger Information Reporting (Electronic) Regulations No. 2 of 2015 that came into operation from 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations promulgated under the Customs Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for advance passenger information reporting. It creates new regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and enforcement mechanisms, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal regulations rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
